steps.name: fire_during
steps.desc: Mid-stroke, still pressed: a blaze laid from the forest (x < 0) into the meadow along a gentle S; flame cards over the mask, the ground not yet ash and the trees not yet snags

steps.name: fire_after
steps.desc: Released: one 'Lay fire' entry; the flames stay, the forest under them is the burnt forest's snags, the meadow keeps its grass, and ash lies under and just past the whole line

steps.name: fire_erased
steps.desc: Ctrl+drag over the meadow end (x 4 to 10): the flames there are out, the ash stays; the forest part still burns over its snags

steps.title: F1 fire-mask-brush
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/fire_mask.json. A new 100 ft grassland meadow (seed 4242) with temperate forest painted over x < 0, a blaze laid with the Fire tool across the forest edge into the meadow, then put out over its meadow end. Nothing is saved.
